detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

Concrete one: outbound reminders that actually cut no-shows.
1. POST /v1/calls with the customer's number + appointment context
2. CallNode dials — your agent confirms the time or reschedules on the spot
3. A call.completed webhook returns the outcome: confirmed, moved, or voicemail
No dialer software. No phone tree. An API call that makes a phone call.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
